references.text: Moses reiterates the condition that the tribes of Gad and Reuben must cross the Jordan armed before the Lord to fight, as confirmation of the agreement.
The Gadites and Reubenites promise to arm themselves and go into battle ahead of the Israelites, as Moses required in verse 20.
Moses reminds the tribes of the command to cross over armed before their brothers for battle, as he established in Numbers.
Joshua reminds the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half-tribe of Manasseh of Moses' command to go armed ahead of their brothers.
Fulfillment of the promise: The men of Reuben, Gad, and half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed before the Lord for battle, as Moses had commanded.
A previous example of Israelites arming themselves for war before the Lord, as preparation for holy war.
